DrillReport.competency-radar-key: Please evaluate your strengths and weaknesses from the radar chart's five dimensions of building a high-performance team. Next, we will provide targeted feedback based on the behaviors you demonstrated during the simulation.
DrillReport.competency-key: Work morale and work competence are two factors that directly affect work performance. Adjust your leadership style by accurately observing what team members need and what the situation requires, then take appropriate actions to improve work performance. High performance drives results.
DrillReport.adaptability-explain: The way leaders manage team members in different situations affects their work competence and work morale, ultimately impacting results. If leaders consistently choose the right way to manage team members, it will enhance work competence and work morale, leading to better results. On the other hand, if leaders consistently choose inappropriate styles, it will lead to a decline in work competence and work morale, resulting in decreased performance.

DrillReport.style-explain: In the simulation, you used different styles to lead the team in various scenarios. The extent to which you used these different styles and their effectiveness are described below.
DrillReport.style-propotion-explain: The proportion of one style compared to others (100%).
DrillReport.style-accuracy-explain: This shows the matching effectiveness of the selected leadership style, expressed as a percentage of 100%.
DrillReport.style-1-instruct-explain: The 'Directive' style involves the leader setting specific goals, making plans, prioritizing, instructing details, teaching step-by-step, and providing timely feedback.
DrillReport.style-2-coach-explain: The 'Coaching' style involves the leader explaining the context of tasks and providing specific requirements. When subordinates perform well, timely recognition is given. Work standards are set, and continuous guidance is provided.
DrillReport.style-3-partner-explain: The 'Collaborative' style involves the leader making decisions together with subordinates. The leader focuses more on guiding, listening, discussing, and supporting. More attention is given to subordinates' opinions and suggestions. Subordinates are encouraged to try solving problems on their own.
DrillReport.style-4-deligate-explain: The 'Delegative' style involves the leader delegating tasks to subordinates to complete independently. More trust, recognition, and affirmation are given. Subordinates are given more challenges. The leader reduces involvement in planning and control of details. The leader delegates daily tasks to subordinates but provides support and assistance when needed.

DrillReport.style-1-instruct-plal: You often personally support some team members. You can further improve team members' work performance by only 'directing' those who will benefit from your style.

DrillReport.style-2-coach-pn: You did not attempt to use the 'Coaching' style to manage the team.
DrillReport.style-2-coach-plal: You often coach your team members. You can improve efficiency by only coaching those who truly benefit from it.
DrillReport.style-2-coach-plah: You very frequently coach your team members and demonstrate high adaptability in coaching those who truly benefit from it, and you only do so when needed.
DrillReport.style-2-coach-phal: You fully used the 'Coaching' style. You can improve efficiency by only coaching those who truly benefit from it.
DrillReport.style-2-coach-phah: You fully used the 'Coaching' style. You demonstrated high adaptability in coaching those who truly benefit from it, and you only did so when needed.

DrillReport.impact-set-goal-explain: Prioritization plays a key role in helping team members focus on what is important to the project, the team, and themselves. It is crucial to conduct goal-setting discussions in a way that best suits team members.
DrillReport.impact-set-goal-explain-VH: Your attempts to help your team members set priorities were very successful. You demonstrated the ability to understand team members' needs and helped them identify priorities.
DrillReport.impact-set-goal-explain-MH: Your attempts to help your team members set priorities were somewhat successful. You did well in understanding team members' needs and helped them identify priorities.
DrillReport.impact-set-goal-explain-ML: You had mixed results in helping your team members identify priorities. You need to understand team members' needs to effectively help them identify priorities.
DrillReport.impact-set-goal-explain-VL: You had little success in helping your team members set priorities. You need to understand team members' needs to effectively help them identify priorities.
DrillReport.impact-set-goal-explain-B: You did not successfully help your team members set priorities. You need to understand team members' needs to effectively help them identify priorities.
DrillReport.impact-coaching-explain: Coaching is an effective way to engage team members and improve their work competence and work performance. Choose the right team members and the right coaching style for the best results.
DrillReport.impact-coaching-explain-VH: Your attempts to coach your team members had a very positive impact on work morale and performance. You adopted the right style for the people you chose. Well done!
DrillReport.impact-coaching-explain-MH: Your attempts to coach your team members had a positive impact on work morale and work performance. You adopted the right style for the people you chose. You can try more in the future.
DrillReport.impact-coaching-explain-ML: Your attempts to coach your team members had an adverse impact on work morale and performance. It seems that the style you adopted was not entirely suitable for the people you chose. You will have to consider more before choosing whom to coach and more carefully match the style.
DrillReport.impact-coaching-explain-VL: Your attempts to coach your team members had a negative impact on work morale and performance. It seems that the style you adopted was mostly unsuitable for the people you chose. You must consider and more carefully match the style before choosing whom to coach.
DrillReport.impact-coaching-explain-B: Your attempts to coach your team members had a very bad impact on work morale and performance. It seems that the style you adopted was completely unsuitable for the people you chose. You must seriously consider and more carefully match the style before choosing whom to coach.
DrillReport.impact-feedback-explain: Providing the right feedback at the right time in the right way can be a powerful tool to improve work morale and keep work performance on track.
DrillReport.impact-feedback-explain-VH: Your attempts to provide feedback had a very positive impact on team members' work morale and improved their performance.
DrillReport.impact-feedback-explain-MH: Your attempts to provide feedback had a positive impact on team members' work morale and improved their performance.
DrillReport.impact-feedback-explain-ML: Your attempts to provide feedback had a negative impact on team members' work morale and affected their performance.
DrillReport.impact-feedback-explain-VL: Your attempts to provide feedback had a fairly negative impact on team members' work morale and adversely affected their performance.
DrillReport.impact-feedback-explain-B: Your attempts to provide feedback severely impacted team members' work morale and reduced their performance.

DrillReport.dist-title: Distribution of Leadership Actions Related to Managing Team Performance
DrillReport.dist-explain: This table focuses on two aspects—numbers and colors. If more boxes are zero, it indicates that you have not used all available leadership actions. On the other hand, if most boxes have numbers, it indicates that you have used most of the available leadership actions.
DrillReport.dist-number-explain: The number in each box indicates the number of times a leadership action had an impact on team members.
DrillReport.dist-order-explain: Team members are ranked in descending order based on the impact of each of your actions on them. The most positive is at the top, and the least positive is at the bottom.
DrillReport.dist-gradient-explain: The gradient of each box indicates the impact of each leadership action on team members' work performance.
DrillReport.food4thought-explain: Here are some questions to help you better understand your leadership behaviors
DrillReport.food4thought-q1: Do you pay attention to and interact with all team members? If not, why not? Why do some team members get more of your time and attention, while others get less or none at all?
DrillReport.food4thought-q1-explain: Giving appropriate attention to all team members and regularly interacting with them is necessary to drive performance.
DrillReport.food4thought-q2: Do you unconsciously favor or neglect some members of the team?
DrillReport.food4thought-q2-explain: Bias, even if unconscious, can be perceived by others and have a negative impact on work morale.
DrillReport.food4thought-q3: Which actions do you prefer or are more willing to take, and why?
DrillReport.food4thought-q3-explain: The actions taken to lead a team may depend on how you prefer to be led.
DrillReport.food4thought-q4: What kind of impact do certain actions have on team members? Why do you think the same action has one impact on one team member and a completely different impact on another?
DrillReport.food4thought-q4-explain: The impact of leadership actions is influenced by team members' situations and mindsets. Continuous communication, evaluation, and adaptation are crucial for your success.
DrillReport.takeaways-explain: Thank you for participating in the digital simulation of building a high-performance team! We hope you had a great experience. As we summarize, here are some suggestions for next steps
DrillReport.takeaways-1: A great leader focuses on achieving team goals by enabling team members.
DrillReport.takeaways-2: Team members' work morale and work competence are equally important for their good performance. They play the same role in team performance.
DrillReport.takeaways-3: Keep communication channels open and better understand your team members. This will help you take the right leadership actions to improve their work morale, work competence, and work performance.
DrillReport.takeaways-4: Continuously evaluate your team members and proactively use leadership actions such as role adjustments, training, goal setting, coaching, feedback, and delegation to enhance their work competence.
DrillReport.takeaways-5: Provide constructive feedback as needed, including timely praise and corrective criticism. Regular attention and face-to-face meetings can also improve work morale.
DrillReport.takeaways-6: Challenge your team members. Motivate, support, and celebrate successes to improve and maintain work performance.
DrillReport.takeaways-7: Adopt the appropriate leadership style based on team members' work competence and work morale levels. Adapt to your team members' development needs.

DrillReport.about-explain: is an engaging digital leadership simulation application that helps you better understand your leadership methods for team members. In the simulation, you will play the role of the team leader. Leading a diverse team of 10 members, your goal is to help team members succeed through leadership and achieve team performance through them.
DrillReport.about-report-1: The report will display your various performances in this digital simulation through icons, charts, and text.
DrillReport.about-report-2: To gain insights from this report, relate the results to the leadership behaviors you took in the simulation.
DrillReport.about-report-3: The summary section provides questions to help you reflect.
DrillReport.about-report-4: The data in this report only reflects the results of this round of simulation. If the environment and conditions change, the data will also change accordingly. This is hereby stated.
DrillReport.about-report-5: It also provides some ideas for you to use as guidance when managing your team.
DrillReport.efficiency-explain: Below are the average scores of team members. Different team leaders tend to spend different amounts of time on team members based on their performance levels. This table highlights whether you prefer to spend more time on low-performing or high-performing employees.
